title: Haus Method (modified PPL)
author: Jake H.
desc:
Modified push pull legs split with a focus on exercises that build an X-Frame that SCREAMS POWER. Aim is to force width in the shoulders and lats, while building thick strong quads and hams. 

This is a bulking program. We are eating in a surplus so we can enhance performance and not cause detriment to it. 

Don’t eat like a bird and don’t be a fat ass and I promise you will get jacked, stacked, and strong as MF.

ex.note: Work sets are in the 6-15 range to allow for a wider window of progression. If you can’t add reps at last weeks weight, add weight and hit a 6-8 rep PR, and continue progressing next week.
Stretch at the bottom and think about rounding your shoulders in at the top so you feel stronger contraction at the top.
For completion. If you have a bad grip (get a stronger grip) but in the meantime, swap for lying leg raises. If you have a weak core, do knee raises.

ss.note: Don’t shorten the range of motion. Feel the stretch at the bottom, and control every rep. Don’t pause at the top and maintain a constant controlled tempo. DONT GO FAST BUT NOT TOO SLOW.
Use the same incline bench and turn around with a pair of dumbbells that are heavy enough to feel like hard work but moderate enough that you can control it and feel your rear delts inflate.

ex.note: Adjust how long you go depending on how fat you are. If you’re scared to talk your shirt off, go longer. It’s not rocket science.
They were good enough for Bill Kazmaier and they’re good enough for you. Use straps if you have them. Control the reps, don’t hop around like an idiot. Feel the traps getting worked.
Nobody likes a pencil neck. Do it. Put a towel or something between you and the plate on your forehead. I just use a knee sleeve. Dont go super heavy either. You can F your shit up here.
For completion. As the weeks progress I want to see you add time or add by hanging a dip belt around your waist or throwing a weight vest on.
Assume dominance and do these in the squat rack. Control the weight. Feel the stretch and get that badass contraction.
Wear weightlifting shoes if you have them. Put your feet low and close together the platform and go as low as possible. Ass to ankles and feel that quad stretch. Push through these reps.
Super set these with squats. I’d rather you do one clean AF rep than 5-10 lame quarter reps. If you can, bring your chest to the bar.
When these start feeling easy, add weight holding a dumbbell or plate. Holding it front is easier, and behind your head is brutal.
Calves are stubborn. So we brutalize them reps. Stretch at the bottom and contract at the top. No bouncy bullshit. I almost puked from these one time. No lie. Bring the intensity.
It’s 8-12 each leg. So 16-24 total reps. Don’t over think these too much. Put some weight on your back and get to work. Power out of the bottom, to build explosiveness. No one likes being slow.
This is important to do if you feel like walking tomorrow.
Mike Israetel does these. Mike Israetel is smart. Mike Israetel is also jacked. Be like Mike. Bring the dumbbells all the way, imagine your delts touching your ears.
You know the drill. Stretch and contract. Go slow but not too slow. If you don’t fear death, set these up like a guillotine press. Vince Gironda did those and they’re sick for upper pecs.
Inflate those puppies with blood. Stretch like hell and contract even harder.
Don’t you want baseballs on your back? Stretch and contract. WORK. You need to bring the intensity here or else it does absolutely jack shit.
Lower intensity from the first time you did these. Just doing a smooth total 100 reps.
Lower intensity. Just pushing blood in the form of 100 juicy reps. Yes, it’s after you do cardio. Just trust me.
Use a mag grip if you got it
No chicken pecking. Pro tip, do these in the mirror because they make you look more jacked than you actually while you’re doing them.
Feel the stretch your glutes and hams. Don’t round your back unless you have a Gypsy girlfriend and people throw tomatoes at you on the weekend. Keep it straight homie.
If you can’t do straight legs, raise your knees. If you can’t do that go to the floor.
If you’re fat, do this for 60 minutes. Thank me later.
